hook.name: Hook
hook.desc: Pull target enemy 1 tile toward caster. Target takes 1 damage.

break.name: Break
break.desc: Remove 1 armor from target. If target has 0 armor and Charge is staged, deals 1 HP damage instead.

steal.name: Steal
steal.desc: Deal 1 damage to target. Caster gains 1 money; target loses 1 money.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.desc: Target takes 1 damage. Pieces in the ring around the target are pushed 1 tile outward. Caster is unaffected.

dash.name: Dash
dash.desc: Move self up to 2 tiles along the Path.

blast.name: Blast
blast.desc: Push target enemy 1 tile away from caster (direction implied by caster→target line).

shove.name: Shove
shove.desc: Push target enemy 1 tile in a chosen direction.

swap.name: Swap
swap.desc: Swap positions with an allied piece. Requires an unobstructed Path.

retreat.name: Retreat
retreat.desc: Move self along the Path to a square adjacent to one of your Guards.

focus.name: Focus
focus.desc: This turn, one non-mystic skill used by any of your pieces gains +1 Range. For Move skills, you choose whether +1 applies to activation range or effect range.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: This turn, one Strike skill used by any of your pieces deals +1 damage.

endphase.name: End Phase
endphase.desc: End the Skill Phase. Unspent actions are forfeit.

wheel.focusStaged: Focus is staged - one non-mystic skill of yours this turn gains +1 Range (for Move skills, you pick activation- or effect-range).
wheel.chargeStaged: Charge is staged - one Strike skill used by any of your pieces this turn deals +1 damage.
wheel.focusAlly: Focus → channel onto an adjacent ally

rules.goalBody: Capture the opponent's King. The game ends immediately when a King is removed from the board.
rules.roundsBody: The game is played in Rounds. Each Round, P1 takes a full turn, then P2. A turn has two phases: Move Phase, then Skill Phase.
rules.moveBody: You have 2 actions. Spend one to move a piece up to its speed. Each piece can only be moved once per phase.
rules.moveAttackBody: Instead of moving into empty space, spend an action to move your piece onto an enemy tile. The enemy takes 1 damage. You may make at most one Move-Attack per turn (normal moves are unrestricted).
rules.healthBody: Every piece has 2 HP: Normal → Injured → Removed. Taking 1 damage moves a piece one step along that track. Injured is purely an HP-tracker - pieces operate at full speed and Range.
rules.armorBody: A piece can hold up to 2 Armor. Each point absorbs 1 incoming damage before HP is affected, then is destroyed.
rules.skillPhaseBody: You have actions (starting at 2 per turn). Spend one action + Money to activate an equipped skill on one of your Champions or King.
rules.moneyBody: Your currency. You earn it automatically each turn (starting at +2/turn, scaling up over time). Skills cost Money.
rules.pathBody: Skills travel in a straight line from the caster (like a chess Queen). That path is blocked by any piece in the way. Most skills have a default range of 2 tiles.
rules.strikeMoveBody: After a Strike skill resolves, the caster steps 1 tile toward the target along the cast direction - but only if that tile is now empty. A point-blank strike that kills lets you step onto the vacated tile; one that doesn't kill leaves you in place. Aggression costs position.
rules.bodyguardBody: When a Champion or King is hit by a Move-Attack, you can choose to have an adjacent Guard take the hit instead.
rules.draftingBody: Before the game, players alternate picking skills from a shared pool and assigning them to their Champions and King. Each piece gets 2 skills.
rules.progressionBody: As the game goes on, your Money income and the number of actions in your Skill Phase both grow - late-game turns are more powerful because you can cast more skills.

controls.selectBody: Click one of your pieces to select it. Legal destinations and skill targets are highlighted on the board.
controls.wheelBody: Select a Champion or King in the Skill Phase to open the skill wheel, then click a slice to arm the skill and click a target tile to cast it.
controls.endBody: Use End Phase to move from the Move Phase to the Skill Phase, and End Turn to pass play to your opponent. Unspent actions are forfeit.
controls.undoBody: Undo reverts your last action within the current turn (local play only).
controls.sandboxBody: Enter sandbox to try out hypothetical moves without committing them. Exit sandbox to restore the real position.
